questions.def: "If" introduces a noun clause expressing doubt or uncertainty.
questions.question: I don't know ___ she is coming to the party.

questions.def: "If" introduces a noun clause acting as the subject of the sentence.
questions.question: ___ you need help, just ask.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause acting as the subject.
questions.question: ___ he said was interesting.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause indicating the object of the verb.
questions.question: Tell me ___ you want to eat.

questions.def: "Where" introduces a noun clause indicating the location.
questions.question: She asked ___ I was going.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause indicating the object of the verb.
questions.question: I don't understand ___ you did.

questions.def: "Whether" introduces a noun clause acting as the subject.
questions.question: ___ he will arrive is uncertain.

questions.def: "That" introduces a noun clause as a complement.
questions.question: It is important ___ we finish on time.

questions.def: "When" introduces a noun clause indicating the time.
questions.question: I will tell you ___ I decide.

questions.def: "If" introduces a noun clause expressing doubt.
questions.question: I am not sure ___ he is telling the truth.

questions.def: "Where" indicates the location of something.
questions.question: Do you know ___ she lives?

questions.def: The verb "believe" is used in its base form.
questions.question: I don't ___ what he said.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause.
questions.question: She knows ___ she wants to do.

questions.def: "Why" introduces the reason for something.
questions.question: He explained ___ he was late.

questions.def: The verb "think" is used in its base form.
questions.question: I ___ that he is right.

questions.def: "Whether" introduces two possible options.
questions.question: It's not clear ___ he will come or not.

questions.def: "Why" is correct here.
questions.question: I want to know ___ you did that.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause as an object.
questions.question: I believe ___ I saw.

questions.def: "What" introduces a noun clause acting as the subject.
questions.question: ___ you decide is up to you.

questions.def: "Where" specifies location.

questions.def: "What" refers to something that happened.
questions.question: Tell me ___ happened.

questions.def: "When" refers to the time the meeting occurs.
questions.question: We don't know ___ the meeting will be held.

questions.def: "What" refers to an action or thing.
questions.question: Tell me ___ you are doing.

questions.def: 'Where' introduces a noun clause indicating location of the action.
questions.question: I don't know ___ she went.

questions.def: 'What' introduces a noun clause functioning as the subject.
questions.question: ___ he said was not true.

questions.def: Need the base form after 'can't' and before the noun clause.
questions.question: I can't ___ what to eat.

questions.def: 'What' is the correct interrogative to use with 'time'.
questions.question: Do you know ___ time the meeting starts?

questions.def: 'If' introduces a noun clause functioning as object of the verb 'asked'.
questions.question: She asked me ___ I wanted to go.

questions.def: Need the base form after 'don't' and before noun clause.
questions.question: I don't ___ what he says.

questions.def: 'That' introduces a noun clause after the adjective 'important'.
questions.question: It's important ___ you finish your work.
